SYC.note: The Data Protection Act 2023 and Cyber Crime Act 2021 are cited as steps towards AI governance but are not said to apply to AI or deepfakes.
Only the National Assembly's research use of AI tools under human supervision is stated, and it says AI is not yet integrated in its operations; no government body.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
The Data Protection Act 2023 is named but its commencement, authority or application is not stated.
Data sovereignty appears only as a seminar topic; no policy or rule is stated.
